"importance": "This steepening is significant as it affects bank profitability (since banks borrow short and lend long), investor positioning in bonds and equities, and economic indicators. "evidence": "As of October 14, 2026, US Treasury yields were: 1-Year: 4.53%, 2-Year: 4.86%, 5-Year: 5.05%, 10-Year: 5.24%, 30-Year: 5.56%. The curve steepened further in late October 2026, with the 2-year yield surging +54 basis points and the 10-year yield leaping +54 basis points since the end of August. The steepening is confirmed by multiple sources as a bear steepener, with the long end rising due to term premium expansion.",
"sources": [
"FRED | St. Louis Fed",
"StreetStats",
"Morningstar",
"24/7 Wall St.",
"MarketWise",
"FinvestLog",
"Reuters",
"Zacks Investment Management",
